{{Infobox Boss |type= |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Igneo Talus Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Igneo Talus Model.png|320x320px]] |Model AoI= [[File:AoI Igneo Talus Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite AoI= {{Please Upload|File:AoI Igneo Talus Icon.png}} }} |caption= |title= |race= |gender= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |dungeon= |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |health= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{HP|BotW|800}} |TotK= {{HP|TotK|1,000}} }} |attack= 60, 2 |weakness= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{List| * [[Ore Deposit]] }} |TotK= {{List| * [[Ore Deposit]] }} }} |reward= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{Icon List|BotW| * Flint * Opal * Ruby * Diamond }} |TotK= {{Icon List|TotK| * Igneo Talus Heart * Flint * Opal * Ruby * Diamond }} |AoC= {{Icon List|AoC| * Flint * Opal * Topaz }} }} |exp= 35 |theme= |strategy= |voiceactor= }} {{Term/Store|Igneo Talus|Igneo Taluses|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Sub-Boss]]es in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} They are a fiery variant of [[Stone Talus]]es. ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Igneo Talus}} Igneo Taluses are a variation of [[Stone Talus]]es that are indigenous to the [[Eldin Canyon]]. They disguise themselves as the molten rocks that can be found throughout the Canyon. Igneo Taluses attack patterns are much the same as their Stone counterparts. However, if [[Link]] comes into direct contact with with an Igneo Talus, he will catch [[Fire]]. To prevent this, he can wear [[Flamebreaker Armor]] that has been enhanced twice by a [[Great Fairy]], as its [[Fireproof]] [[Set Bonus]] will protect him. Alternatively, Link can attack the Talus with [[Ice]]-based [[Weapon]]s to cool it down temporarily. An Igneo Talus is large and slow-moving, with its main attacks being to launch pieces of its arms at Link, crash down in an attempt to fall on him, or taking a large swing at him. To hurt Igneo Taluses, Link must hit the [[Ore Deposit]] protruding from their bodies. This can be accomplished by climbing onto it when it falls over, using a longer range [[Weapon]], or by using a [[Bow]] to hit it with [[Arrow]]s. When struck, the Ore Deposits will occasionally drop pieces of [[Flint]], [[Opal]]s, [[Ruby|Rubies]], and [[Diamond]]s. Using the [[Remote Bomb]] [[Rune]], Link can cause an Igneo Talus to fall over, making its Ore Deposit easier to access. As part of the [[Side Quest]] "[[The Road to Respect]]", Link learns that [[Rohan]] tasked [[Fugo]] with defeating every Igneo Talus around [[Goron City]], but he has been unable to reach the one at [[Darunia Lake]]. Once Link has defeated this Igneo Talus, Fugo will offer to buy the achievement for him for 100 [[Rupee]]s. If Link accepts, Fugo will give him a [[Silver Rupee]]. After Link has defeated [[Calamity Ganon]] for the first time, he will be able to talk about Stone Taluses with [[Kilton]] at the [[Fang and Bone]]. He reveals that he has been unable to research them due to their massive size, so he asks Link to defeat all of the Talus in [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]] so he can analyze the scents they leave behind. This count includes all of the Igneo Taluses in Eldin Canyon. Once all of the Talus have been killed, Kilton will give Link the [[Medal of Honor: Talus]] as a reward. By analyzing their scents, Kilton is able to learn about the musculoskeletal structure and diet of Taluses. As part of {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack, the [[Igneo Talus Titan]] will appear at [[Lake Darman]].
